text:
Math-Driven vs. AI-Reasoned: Navigating the Epistemic Boundary.

What does it take to build mission-critical scientific software? You cannot rely on generative AI for quantitative truth.

In Z-WBE, 12 transparent scaling equations handle the hard mathematics:
- Exabyte storage volumes
- Multi-beam SEM scan durations
- Terabytes-per-second memory bandwidth

Nemotron handles the qualitative 'why': explaining why accelerating acquisition by 100x exposes the memory wall.

Mastering this boundary between deterministic computation and probabilistic AI is how top engineers build reliable software.
